subject: Welcome to Redwood — pick a 20m slot to walk through inference
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Santos <emily@nimbusanalytics.com>
Date: 2029-06-30T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Welcome to Redwood — pick a 20m slot to walk through inference
Cc: 

Hi Emily,

Thanks for signing up for Redwood — welcome! I’m Karthik on the demo/SDR team. Quick note to get you set up: I’ve got a 20‑minute slot grid for short product + technical walkthroughs. If you’re evaluating how Redwood could help reduce token cost/latency for inference at scale, pick a convenient slot here: https://cal.redwood.ai/karthik-20m

Before the call, a couple quick asks so we can tailor the session:
- What workload are you testing (chat, generation, embeddings)?
- Approx. RPS or concurrent users you expect?
- Any strict compliance/regulatory reqs we should be aware of?

I’ve attached a short one‑pager and a demo agenda template so you can see what we typically cover. If you prefer, reply with 2–3 preferred times (include timezone) and I’ll lock something in.

If you don’t need a live walkthrough and just want to try the self‑serve flow, you’ll still get an engineer follow‑up with best practice notes after you spin up a sandbox.

Looking forward to it — pick a time that works and I’ll confirm.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
SDR, Redwood Inference
kk: +1 (415) 555-0182
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- redwood-one-pager.pdf (PDF, 1pg)
- demo-agenda-template.md (MD, 1 file)

Date: 2029-06-30T15:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Welcome to Redwood — pick a 20m slot to walk through inference
Cc: 

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the quick note.

We’re primarily testing chat summarization + semantic search (embeddings) for a user‑facing analytics product. Expected peak is ~30 RPS initially, ramping to ~150 during heavy queries. Compliance: SOC 2 is important; also interested in retention controls.

I tried the calendar link but the times are a little thin for our EMEA stakeholder — I’m in PDT and a few folks are in CET. Can we do one of these (all times my TZ = PDT):
- Thu Jul 4, 9:00am PDT
- Thu Jul 4, 4:30pm PDT (that should catch CET at ~1:30am — hmm, not great)
- Fri Jul 5, 11:00am PDT

If none work, I can share 2–3 CET windows and you can pick.

Best,
Emily
Emily Santos
Platform Lead, Nimbus Analytics
emily@nimbusanalytics.com
+44 7700 123456

Hey Emily — thanks for the context, that’s super helpful. 30 RPS ramping to 150 is exactly the kind of profile we optimize for. SOC 2 + retention controls are supported — I’ll have an engineer cover the technical knobs for caching, KV prefixing, and quantization during the call.

I’m cc’ing Ben (AE) to help find a slot that works for your CET stakeholders. Ben — Emily suggested Thu Jul 4 at 9:00am PDT or Fri Jul 5 at 11:00am PDT as options; she’s also open to you proposing CET windows. Could you lock one in or propose two CET‑friendly times?

Agenda for the 20m call (we’ll share a fiddler link and a short kb):
- 5m: quick intros & goals
- 10m: architecture walkthrough + perf/cost levers specific to chat+embeddings
- 5m: next steps & sandbox access

Emily — I’m attaching the one‑pager again and a short demo agenda. If you already have dataset examples or a short prompt set, feel free to drop them in reply and we’ll load a quick sample.

Thanks — Karthik

Attachments:
